name: Support Agent Review
description: Audits an AI customer-support agent session trace: checks resolution, factual consistency, policy adherence, escalation need, customer sentiment, and predicted CSAT.

issue_resolved.instructions: The customer's issue was fully resolved within the session.

criteria.true: The need that drove the contact was met, or reliably set in motion, by the end of the session.
criteria.false: The need was unmet, partially handled, or depends on steps that never happened.

factually_consistent.instructions: Everything the agent told the customer is consistent with the data returned by its tools.

criteria.true: Every statement made to the customer matches the tool results in the trace.
criteria.false: The agent told the customer something its own tool results do not support or contradict.

policy_adherence.instructions: The agent's actions complied with the policies and procedures surfaced by its own tool calls during the session.

criteria.true: Every action respected the limits, approvals, and required steps stated in the session's policy data.
criteria.false: At least one action violated or skipped something the session's own policy data requires.

escalation_needed.instructions: This session needs human follow-up or review.

criteria.true: A person must intervene: outstanding commitments, missing approvals, or unresolved customer needs remain.
criteria.false: Nothing remains that requires a person.

customer_sentiment.instructions: What is the customer's sentiment at the close of the conversation?

criteria.positive: The customer ends pleased or grateful.
criteria.neutral: The customer ends matter-of-fact, neither pleased nor upset.
criteria.negative: The customer ends dissatisfied, frustrated, or angry.
criteria.mixed: The customer expresses clearly conflicting feelings at the close.

predicted_csat.instructions: Predict the satisfaction rating this customer will give in a follow-up survey.
criteria: Very dissatisfied: likely complaint, chargeback, or churn.
Dissatisfied: the outcome will fall short of what was promised or expected.
Neutral: acceptable outcome with noticeable friction.
Satisfied: issue handled competently and promptly.
Very satisfied: fast, complete resolution that exceeds expectations.
